name: Alfaz Khan
bio: Alfaz Khan is an infrastructure and security practitioner with over 15 years of experience leading enterprise IT operations across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. He specializes in multi-site infrastructure management, cybersecurity governance, and ITIL-aligned service delivery — with hands-on expertise across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Microsoft 365. He holds CISSP and CCSP designations from ISC², alongside ITIL v4 Foundation and Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert certifications.

Before settling in Vancouver, BC, Alfaz held senior technical leadership roles across East Africa's enterprise IT market, leading cloud migrations, security deployments, and Microsoft Azure engagements for clients across the region. He brings a uniquely international perspective to infrastructure and security — having managed IT budgets exceeding $2M and overseen technology operations for organizations spanning multiple sites and hundreds of end users.
